snippet.title: How to play T7's Basics in Educational
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION:

Just don't make anything wrong with this game... because T7 will start finding you after the second laptop you collect it.

THERE'S MORE! Including the cafeteria and even Drawer the Pencil, which he draws. Alongside Bubble which gives tips and others can tell it to also change! Even more characters! What about Rex?
But Mara is luckily here.

She kicks Rex for sweeping after she finds Rex, and yes, he's the sweeper.

Questions

 1. Why are the doors locked except for classroom doors?

To prevent players getting out early without the 2nd laptops, I decided to add blocker so it will prevent a player getting out alongside the NPCs (maybe...)

 2.  Is the game free?

Originally, yes! It is intended to be a free game.

 3. Does the cafeteria have foods?

 While yes, these are not interactable.

 4. If T7 now finds you, after getting caught, will you get mystery room?

Well, no, but rather shows game over screen.

T7's Basics in Educational - by MMT125
